integrity: Exact all-size proof from ternary local feasibility, Jacobi complementary minors and symmetric Schur complements. Finite exact checker checks sizes m=1 through 4, not the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Pure countable atomless Boolean algebra; finite named nonempty subalgebra; only existential disjointness feasibility for pairs of complete nonalgebraic one-types. No exhaustive priority or independent mathematical audit.
title: Primitive disjointness matrices of nonalgebraic Boolean one-types
